name: curAnimId
meaning: current animation id (ScnBody-level field)

name: groundPos
meaning: ground point under the object (+0x66 = ground height)

name: bodyRadius
meaning: collision box max.y * 3/2, recomputed on scale change

name: airTime
meaning: air timer, zeroed by climb/swim/float/rise steps

name: idleCountdown
meaning: random number of idle loops before an idle variation

name: climbZones
meaning: prop CLIMBBOXES list (record+0x14) {Box **boxes; u16 count}; ctx action 0xF/0x11. One field: Wolf_ClimbBoxWalkStep keeps its address in an inline temp and reads count and boxes through it (0x48af87-0x48afa7), the shape of an inlined ZoneList member on the list

name: trailA
meaning: 0x164-byte ribbon emitter (ptrs +0x128->+0x14C, +0x12C->+0x20C, count byte +0x149=16, flags byte +0x14A bit0 active)

name: particles
meaning: 0x2C-byte emitter (ctor 0x52dc84), flags byte +0x2AE

name: wallAvoid
meaning: wall-steering helper (the Wolf counterpart of Sheep+0xC4): asm add ecx,0x2b0 before 0x493ecb, 0x494116 and 0x493e80. 8 bytes, ends where propBody (+0x2b8) begins

name: propBody
meaning: embedded body showing one of 8 prop models (own pos +0x2C4, rot +0x2CC, model +0x2BC, anim +0x2F8, anim flags +0x31A, cur anim +0x312); it is also the attached secondary model (ice block / puff) - the old inferred row +0x2bc secondaryModelAnim described this same body's anim part

name: propRecord
meaning: fake level record for propBody (0x5100ae); u16 words like every WAR record

name: propModels
meaning: alt-model table for propBody (ids g_wolfPropModelIds)

name: splashBody
meaning: water-entry splash body (class 0x5A record), pos +0x3CC, model +0x3C4, anim +0x400, anim flags +0x422

name: splashRecord
meaning: fake record for splashBody; u16 words like every WAR record

name: waterZone
meaning: current water box (flags: 0x1000000 freezing, 0x2000000 sink-through); a Box: flags +0, min.y (the water surface) +6 read by the swim steps (0x48b13d movsx eax,word [ecx+6]) Also read as word [zone+6] at 0x48e2eb, 0x48ed78, 0x48ee0e.

name: trailB
meaning: second ribbon emitter (flags +0x45E)

name: modelSets
meaning: 0x10 each; index = modelSet; entry 4 id at +0x5E0

name: stateTime
meaning: ticks since state entry

name: footstepTimer
meaning: ticks since last footstep sound (cap 0x1E000); step when >= animDuration/2

name: runTapTimer
meaning: run tap timer; reused as mash window (0x4f) and flatten timer (0xd5)

name: landDustTimer
meaning: min(airTime>>3,0x400) at landing; counts down while landing dust trail plays

name: animDurationTicks
meaning: current anim length in ticks

name: lastObjectContactTime
meaning: g_gameTime when the mover last touched a scenaric object (contact[0]); FB 0x20 for 0x400 ticks

name: lastContact2Time
meaning: g_gameTime when contact[2] was non-zero; FB 0x10 for 0x400 ticks (meaning of contact[2] not decoded)

name: flattenDuration
meaning: ticks Ralph stays flattened (arg of msg 0x41b)

name: stepSoundCount
meaning: sneak step counter (pitch/volume ramp, max 8) / run-start sound played

name: loopSfxHandle
meaning: handle of the looping/state sound

name: dropOffset
meaning: offset added to drop position with Wolf_DropHeld flag 8 (msg 0x428)

name: heldObject
meaning: object in hand / carried (mode 1)

name: grabber
meaning: object that froze the Wolf (msg 0xE); polled with msg 0x6B/0x49

name: coverObject
meaning: cover Ralph hides behind (kept by state flag 0x8000)

name: killer
meaning: object that crushed / sucked Ralph; 0x10 snaps onto its box top, 0x3c is pulled to it

name: magnetTarget
meaning: Wolf msg 0x53 stores arg[0], and the only 0x53 sender (Magnet_Update 0x4d2650) passes {candidate, reply} to its holder. So this is the metal object the held magnet caught (the first one found this frame). Cleared every frame by Wolf_Update 0x4840ca; Wolf_StrafeAroundFocusStep (states 0xC8/0xC9) faces it.

name: ctxAction
meaning: ActionHit {action, target}: action = WolfContextAction; target = object offering the context action

name: heldActionType
meaning: WolfHeldAction (also overwritten per state for the HUD prompt)

name: ctx4PromptIndex
meaning: 4th word of the 0x10-byte context block; read as the index into g_wolfCtx4PromptText; writer not established

name: coverAction
meaning: ActionHit {action, target}: action = 1 = cover zone available; target = cover zone record (side 0..3 via 0x491bf2)

name: coverWord2
meaning: 3rd word of the 0x10-byte cover block at +0x650 (after the ActionHit coverAction.action/coverAction.target); only ever zeroed (Wolf_ScanContextActions 0x4902e0, 0x487d55)

name: coverWord3
meaning: 4th word of the cover block; only ever zeroed (0x4902ed, 0x487d62)

name: itemPromptClassId
meaning: u16 class id drawn by Scenaric_DrawClassIcon for the held-item prompt; Hud_DrawItemPrompt 0x493a7f passes this word to Scenaric_DrawClassIcon as a class id (the held item's msg 6 reply word 0: GoldenCoins 0x8d; Robot_ClearState writes 0x65 = Robot).

name: itemPromptLevel
meaning: Word 1 of the msg 6 reply (0..0xffff, e.g. coin distance*0xffff/600). Hud_DrawItemPrompt copies it to 0x57b26e and draws the crayon frame in 0x502828 when < 0xe665, else 0x101050.

name: bush
meaning: Bush being worn

name: elastic
meaning: elastic being pulled (set by 0x491960)

name: launchPath
meaning: per-axis {p0,v,a} quadratic trajectory from msg 0xC plus its parameter t (+0x690); Wolf_LaunchArcStep keeps the address this+0x66c in an inline temp and reads t as [temp+0x24] (0x48bfe9-0x48bff8)

name: frozenRiver
meaning: cached class 0x53 object; msg 0x36

name: sheepCostumeListener
meaning: object notified with msg 0x69 when Ralph bleats

name: timeOutOfWater
meaning: ticks since leaving water (cap 0x3C000); wet footprints while <0x14000

name: savedBodyBox
meaning: original collision box copied back before rescaling

name: savedBox
meaning: the same 16 bytes as a CollBox: Wolf::PostLoadInit copies the first model box here

name: restrictions
meaning: prop RESTRICTIONBOX list {Box **boxes; u16 count} (flag 0x40000000 = no run): Wolf_FilterInput takes its address as one pointer (0x48e0ff add ecx,0x6c0) and reads [p] and word [p+4]

name: flyBox
meaning: prop FLYBOX: rocket flight clamp

name: updraftZone
meaning: current updraft zone, 0 = left it; a Box: flags +0 (0x40000000 lift, 0x20000000 double), min.y +6 (0x48bb32)

name: glowDist
meaning: min distance to a light source this frame (msg 0x424); <0x200 tints, reset to 0x7fffffff

name: distanceTravelled
meaning: accumulated XZ distance (msg 0x41A returns it)

name: bushNibbleTimer
meaning: accumulates g_dt on msg 1 from a sheep in flag-0x10000 state; at 0x14000 -> state 0xA

name: scriptWalkTarget
meaning: destination of scripted walk (msg 0x12)

name: scriptWalkHeading
meaning: final facing of scripted walk

name: fallLimitY
meaning: Y the death falls stop at

name: waterDepthOffset
meaning: offset added to water top for wade/swim thresholds

name: carryDropPos
meaning: place position passed with msg 0x981 in state 0x15

name: lineHeading
meaning: constrained heading (elastic via msg 0x2d, fishing rod)

name: savedCamRot
meaning: camera rot saved when leaving follow mode

name: savedCamDist
meaning: default 0x262

name: interactPos
meaning: mine position (0xd0) / dance spot (0xc0)

name: interactHeading
meaning: heading to hold during interactions

name: mashCount
meaning: action presses while frozen (10 to break out)

name: danceMove
meaning: current dance move 0..3, 0xff none. u8: the only read is movzx eax,byte [edx+0x70c]; cmp eax,0xff (Wolf_StateMachine 0x481ef8)

name: state
meaning: WolfState / WolfStateCarry id; switch variable

name: mode
meaning: 0 normal, 1 carrying lifted object; selects bank and state table

name: surface
meaning: 0 normal / 1 ice: selects per-surface tuning and record table

name: playerIndex
meaning: 0/1 from g_wolfInstanceCount; 1 uses pad 0x719698

name: modelSet
meaning: active model set (index into +0x5A0)

name: costume
meaning: 0 none, 4 rabbit

name: camOverride
meaning: 0xFF none

name: fxFlags
meaning: attached-effect flags: 4 ice block floating, 8 dizzy fx, 0x4000 costume puff, 0x100000 ice block grounded, 0x800000 carry-drop target valid

name: flags
meaning: bits seen here: 0x200000 / 0x400000 lock the stick heading to one axis, 0x400/0xC00 resp. 0/0x800, 0x200000 winning (Wolf_GetStickHeading 0x488be0, match-compiled); 4 run flag, 0x1000/0x2000 slope, 0x4000 item being taken out, 0x8000 frozen anchored, 0x10000 trap pulse, 0x20000 in trap, 0x40000 wading sfx, 0x80 script done, 0x10000000 pushed by platform, 0x2000000 safe fall, 0x80000000
